title: Linc Ltd-$ - 531241 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Linc Q2 FY27 operating income rose 10.8% YoY to ₹15,412 lakhs, but EBITDA margin fell to 7.3% from 11.3%.
summary.overview: Operating income grew 10.8% YoY and 10.9% QoQ to ₹15,412 lakhs, helped by sales promotion and growth in categories beyond writing instruments. Operating EBITDA was ₹1,131 lakhs at a 7.3% margin, down 393 bps YoY (about 190 bps from raw materials and 200 bps from sales expenditure) and down from 8.7% in Q1. PAT was ₹419 lakhs, a 2.7% margin. Management said margins should recover as raw material prices stabilise, with the West Bengal plant expected to start commercial production around end-December/early January.

financial_highlights.change: Margin 7.3% vs 11.3% YoY and 8.7% in Q1
~190 bps raw material cost, ~200 bps sales expenditure

segments.name: Uni-Linc JV (with Mitsubishi Pencil, Japan)
segments.commentary: Operationally stable; exports above 50% of revenue in H1 FY27. One ball pen launched at ₹20 MRP, gaining distribution and volumes; two more products in pipeline (one soon, one in CY2027).

segments.name: Turkey JV
segments.commentary: Operations progressing steadily; no figures given.

segments.name: Morris of Korea subsidiary / West Bengal plant
segments.commentary: Linked to West Bengal manufacturing facility, expected to be operational in Q3; commercial production now guided for end-December/early January.

segments.name: Kenya subsidiary
segments.commentary: Sales momentum improving; expected to strengthen over coming quarters. No figures given.

segments.name: Linc On
segments.commentary: Growing at a healthy rate; expected to gain further momentum. No figures given.

segments.name: Tri-Tonic / Stackoo
segments.commentary: Tri-Tonic Tritan-based lifestyle drinkware launched for everyday, active and children's use. Stackoo experience centres in Kolkata and Mumbai bring writing instruments and stationery together.

guidance_outlook: Management expects margins to return to historical levels within 4 to 6 quarters, with an improvement visible from Q4, provided raw material prices stay stable.
Management said it would be able to give firmer profitability guidance for next financial year after the next two quarters, once clarity improves.
Priority is to sustain sales growth while rebalancing growth investment against profitability; promotional spending is under review.
West Bengal plant: almost all facilities ready by end-December, commercial production from January; expected to deliver operational efficiency and capacity headroom.
capex_capacity: West Bengal manufacturing facility: infrastructure nearly complete, final production start from January; will replace old facility with modern layout and room for capacity expansion.
No substantial increase in regulatory-driven operating costs expected after commissioning, per management.
Uni-Linc JV: three new products expected over the next 3 to 4 quarters.
demand_pricing: Double-digit sales growth driven by increased sales promotion while holding the underlying price structure unchanged.

Raw material costs rose on geopolitical uncertainty; increases varied by input, and the company's newer raw material mix (developed over the last 1 to 1.5 years) saw smaller cost increases than standard grades such as SAN, ABS, PP and PC.
Margins are better in premium price points above ₹10, which management is prioritising.
New launches across the Pentonic and linked portfolios to cover more price points.

qa_highlights.question: Where do margins settle over the next 4 to 6 quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects a return to historical margins within 4 to 6 quarters, with improvement from Q4 if raw material prices stay stable. It declined to give an exact percentage given volatility.

qa_highlights.question: Status of Uni-Linc JV product launches?
qa_highlights.answer: One ball pen launched at ₹20 MRP, gaining distribution and volume; about 50% of JV revenue from exports. Two more products are in the pipeline, one soon and one in CY2027, so three products over the next 3 to 4 quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Is the West Bengal plant on schedule, and what are the asset turnover and margin expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: Factory nearly set up; commercial production expected by end-December or early January (Q4). Benefits expected mainly from operational efficiency and a modern layout with room for capacity expansion. No asset turnover or margin target was given.

qa_highlights.question: What internal levers can protect margins without stable raw materials?
qa_highlights.answer: Two levers: the newer raw material mix, which has seen smaller cost increases than SAN, ABS, PP and PC, and a greater focus on premium products priced above ₹10 where margins are better.

risks_watch: Raw material volatility linked to geopolitical and crude-linked input costs; management says it cannot predict the trajectory.
Sales promotion spend (about 200 bps of margin drag) must be balanced against profitability.
West Bengal plant commissioning timing (end-December/January) and the resulting ramp-up of export volumes.
Uni-Linc JV pipeline delivery (three products over 3 to 4 quarters) and Kenya/Linc On momentum, which were not quantified.
Q4 margin recovery depends on raw material prices remaining stable.
summary.management_tone: Confident on sales momentum and long-term direction, but cautious on margins: management repeatedly called the raw material situation volatile and declined to give a numeric margin target or FY28 guidance.
key_quotes: The current raw material situation seems quite temporary and we already see an improving trend from the December month based on the recent announcements.
While the higher expenditure weighed on near-term margins, it reflects our focus on gaining market share and building sustained sales momentum.
I am unable to give you exact percentage right now because the situation is quite volatile.

adds.what: West Bengal manufacturing facility (replaces old facility, room for capacity expansion)

growth.why: Operating income grew 10.8% YoY in Q2 FY27 on promotions, with no numeric revenue guidance; margin recovery is expected from Q4 but management declined to give numbers, and the West Bengal plant (commercial production from January, about 1 quarter out) is the main capacity addition with no capex or capacity size disclosed.

rows.label: Margin expansion

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning

rows.label: New capex announcement

rows.label: Guidance downgrade

rows.label: Premium mix above ₹10 price points

tone.note: Management was confident on sales momentum, the West Bengal plant timing and new launches, but cautious on margins, calling raw material volatility unpredictable and declining numeric margin or FY28 guidance; analysts pressed on margin recovery and promotional spend.
